insight.title: The Invisible Architecture
insight.subtitle: Why your biological signature is written into every space you occupy.

sections.text: Every room you enter is instantly rewritten by your presence. Within minutes, you shed millions of bacteria, creating a unique biological "cloud" that lingers long after you have physically departed the space.

This microbial aura is as distinct as a fingerprint. Researchers can now identify individuals simply by sampling the air in a room they recently occupied, detecting the invisible ecosystem we carry and distribute.

We perceive ourselves as self-contained entities, but we are actually porous. We are in a state of constant, invisible exchange with our surroundings, blurring the boundary between where our bodies end and the world begins.
You never truly leave a room empty.
